definitions.explanation: Describes someone who gets angry easily and often. Built from {怒|おこ}る (to get angry) plus the suffix 〜っぽい, which marks a tendency, so it points at a habit rather than a single outburst.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{怒|おこ}りっぽい。
⟦{寝不足|ねぶそく}→寝不足：07692_nebusoku⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{怒|おこ}りっぽく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I get irritable when I haven't had enough sleep.

examples.japanese: {怒|おこ}りっぽい⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{疲|つか}れる→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
examples.english: Working under a short-fused boss is exhausting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧{怒|おこ}りっぽく⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{反省|はんせい}している→反省する：21398_hanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: My wife told me I've become short-tempered lately, and I'm reflecting on it a bit.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {怒|おこ}りっぽい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a quick-tempered person
- {怒|おこ}りっぽく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become irritable (often about a temporary state — tiredness, illness, age)
- {怒|おこ}りっぽい⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: an irritable disposition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気|き}が{短|みじか}い→気が短い：06882_kigamijikai⟧: short-tempered — the same trait stated as an idiom; slightly more neutral in tone
- ⟦{短気|たんき}→短気：10913_tanki⟧: short temper — the noun, used in ⟦{短気|たんき}→短気：10913_tanki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧ (to lose one's temper)
- ⟦{怒|おこ}り→怒る：00876_okoru⟧やすい: easily angered — plainer and more clinical; 〜⟦っぽい→っぽい：06781_ppoi⟧ carries a hint of criticism

USAGE:
Because it sounds mildly critical, speakers rarely apply it to a superior's face; it is normal in describing oneself or a family member.

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {怒|おこ}りっぽくなかったら
